pr_title: Treat empty string comments as no comment in autogenerate
pr_body:
Fixed issue where a table or column comment set to an empty string
would cause autogenerate to detect a comment change on every run.
PostgreSQL (COMMENT ON ... IS '' removes the comment), MySQL / MariaDB
and Oracle don't store an empty string comment distinctly from no
comment, so the comment reflects back as None and the comparison can
never converge.  The table and column comment comparators now treat an
empty string comment the same as None on all backends.

Additionally, create_table / add_column rendering,
DefaultImpl.create_table, toimpl.add_column and the MySQL column spec
used "if comment:", so an empty string comment was never emitted;
these now check "is not None".

Fixes: #1085
Closes: #1871
Pull-request: https://github.com/sqlalchemy/alembic/pull/1871
Pull-request-sha: 5eacb86028259317cc20ee3af078514ec4008314

Change-Id: Ic03ecb29412afabefaee2813bfa2be99637be6f3
